body:
I ordered 1 ounce of Amanita Muscaria caps from a reliable vendor. Me and my friend get them, and an ounce of great weed, along with 2 new bowls. We decided to go ahead and smoke that night. The weed was already potent enough, and we decided to sprinkle Amanita skins on top of the weed.
As the flame hit the skins we could see them shrivel up and dissolve into the weed. It made the smoke taste pretty weird, not bad, just weird. The effects from the amanitas hit very quickly, followed by the effects of weed.
It was deeper than what weed usually was, and gave a bit of an eerie feeling, which wasn't bad at all. It was almost like drinking a tad before smoking pot. But unique in its own way.
Good experience. I wouldn't mind doing it again.
